tailoring.headline: Inhouse SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Senior Java & Techno-Functional Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. Proven techno-functional consultant: analysing business requirements, designing data flows, steering international projects, and ensuring stable operations through incident, change and release management. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and AI-assisted development across platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Pfeiffer Vacuum’s commitment to innovative, customer-centric e-commerce solutions. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and a proven record of delivering integrated digital sales and service platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product catalog, pricing and checkout, ensuring stable e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: Integration & API Design
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST APIs, integrating SAP ERP and MDM systems, directly aligning with SAP CX integration needs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as liaison between business and IT, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and guiding international stakeholders through project delivery.

bullets.label: Production & Release Management
bullets.text: Managed incident, change and release processes in SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), executing CI/CD cycles and supporting global roll-outs.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Pfeiffer Vacuum.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die innovative Ausrichtung von Pfeiffer Vacuum im Bereich Customer Experience begeistert mich. Mit mehr als fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Optimierung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich fundiertes technisches Know-how und bewährte Erfolge in der Umsetzung integrierter Vertriebs- und Serviceprozesse.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich End-to-End-Lösungen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, inkl. Produktkatalog, Preisgestaltung und Checkout, und damit stabile E-Commerce-Prozesse gesichert.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Design
bullets.text: Ich habe PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines und OCC-REST-APIs aufgebaut und SAP ERP sowie MDM angebunden, was exakt den Integrationsanforderungen im SAP-CX-Umfeld entspricht.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und IT analysierte ich Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und steuerte internationale Projektteams.

bullets.label: Betrieb & Release-Management
bullets.text: Ich verantwortete Incident-, Change- und Release-Management im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) und führte CI/CD-Zyklen mit Docker und Kubernetes durch.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und stehe ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: At Pfeiffer Vacuum I see a leader that combines cutting-edge vacuum technology with a forward-looking digital strategy. Your focus on expanding the SAP-CX landscape and delivering seamless customer experiences aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud integration and techno-functional consulting. I am eager to contribute my expertise to drive global roll-outs and innovative e-commerce functionalities for your growing portfolio.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Pfeiffer Vacuum to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, drive integrated e-commerce solutions and support global digital transformation in a company renowned for innovation.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Inhouse Consultant role at Pfeiffer Vacuum and would love to discuss how my integration and consulting experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud position at Pfeiffer Vacuum. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud development and techno-functional consulting experience, I am confident I can contribute to your digital commerce initiatives and explore potential collaborations.
